limitations: Fair iid input letters, classical Černý automata, independently uniform unordered initial pair; no all-state reset time, biased-input law, or full hitting-time distribution is determined.
scientific_integrity: The exact all-n variance formula follows from a specified absorbing Markov chain, a polynomial second-moment Bellman potential, and a finite power-sum identity. Exact finite tests supplement the general proof. Primary prior first-moment analysis is credited; no independent mathematical certification is claimed.
title: Exact second moment of random pair merging in Černý automata
